lines: Candidate C (synthetic CV, written for this demo)
Senior QA Automation Engineer · Florianópolis, Brazil · English: B2
Seven years in test automation for web products, the last three on a browser-based 3D viewer for building models.
Designed the Playwright and TypeScript framework we use across unit, API and end-to-end suites.
Built visual regression tests for a Three.js viewer, comparing canvas snapshots across GPU drivers.
Moved the suites into GitLab CI with sharding; pipeline time fell from 38 to 11 minutes.
Cut flaky tests from 9% to under 1% by rewriting waits and isolating test data.
Automated regression for a React logistics dashboard and its REST APIs with Cypress and Postman.
Wrote the first load tests with k6 for the booking API.
Playwright, TypeScript, JavaScript, Cypress, k6, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Chrome DevTools
Use GitHub Copilot and Claude to draft test cases from acceptance criteria, then review every one.
Comfortable presenting in English to product teams; B2 certificate.
